integrity: All claimed identities are proved in the package. Numerical or finite-dimensional replay is used only as an arithmetic sanity check and not as proof over the quantified infinite range.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for the canonical shrinking regular-simplex family; no global spherical stability modulus, optimality among all shrinking simplices, or fourth-order term is asserted.
title: Second-order curvature gap for the regular-simplex sharpness family in spherical Grünbaum
